property_summary: For all inputs where feeRate > 5000, the reference contract's initialize must revert (preventing initialized from becoming true), whereas the mutant removes this check and will allow initialization with feeRate > 5000, so initialized becomes true for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the feeRate validation to a no-op (commented out), allowing initialize to set feeRate > 5000 and still set initialized to true.
